name: More than you can chew
author: Martin
bootlegger: Shabaloth always regurgitates one player they killed last night. The Shabaloth loses this ability if only 3 people are alive.

Once per game, the Demon can choose themself as one of their two picks. If they were to die that night due to their own ability, they instead register as dead, and will register as alive starting the following night, as if they were regurgitated. The other person they chose last night doesn't get regurgitated.
A sober and healthy regurgitated Shugenja learns the direction of the closest living evil player.
A sober and healthy regurgitated Clockmaker learns how far the Demon (living or registering as dead) is from the closest living Minion.
A sober and healthy regurgitated Chef learns the number of alive evil pairs.
